next_actions.text: Add 'Family owns cultivable land' to your profile. Needed for: Farmer family (husband, wife, minor children) owns cultivable land as per State land records. Keep your Land record (Khasra / B-1) ready as proof.

application_steps: Apply through the village Patwari / revenue official or self-register through "New Farmer Registration" on https://pmkisan.gov.in with name, gender, category, Aadhaar, bank account and IFSC (FAQ Q15, Q17, Q26).
The State Nodal Officer verifies the land records and eligibility (FAQ Q17).
Complete eKYC (OTP, biometric at CSC, or face authentication in the PM-KISAN app).
Check payment status on the portal under "Beneficiary Status" using Aadhaar, account or mobile number.

benefit.description: Rent assistance for 12 months, paid in two six-monthly instalments (July and January): INR 2,000 per month in Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, Jabalpur and Ujjain; INR 1,250 per month at other district headquarters; INR 1,000 per month at tehsil / block headquarters (rate depends on where the student rents, rule 4(2), 4(4)).

rank_reasons: Status: potentially eligible: no condition fails, some information is missing
Benefit: recurring cash (cash; cash benefits rank above non-cash)

next_actions.text: Upload your Caste Certificate so the assistant can read Social category. Needed for: Student belongs to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe (caste certificate).

Upload your Samagra ID / Domicile Certificate (or enter the value yourself) so the assistant can read Household has an MP Samagra ID. Needed for: Student has an MP Samagra ID (application details are verified from Samagra).

After resolving the items above, apply through the official channel described in SC/ST Balak/Balika Awas Sahayata Yojana Navin Niyam 2016, order No. F 12-06/2013/25-2/1860 dated 23/12/2016 (https://hescholarship.mp.gov.in/Public/pdf/Letters/Awas_Sahayata_New_Rule_2016.pdf).

application_steps: After the last date of admission, apply online - SC students on MP Scholarship Portal 2.0 (https://hescholarship.mp.gov.in), ST students on MPTAAS (https://www.tribal.mp.gov.in/MPTAAS) after beneficiary profile registration (rule 5(1); CM Helpline scheme 812).
Upload the previous class mark sheet, an affidavit and the landlord's consent letter / rent agreement (rule 5(2)).
Check all details before locking the application; wrong information leads to rejection (rule 5(3)).

The principal (or nodal government principal for non-government institutions) sanctions it using Samagra details; no hard copy is needed (rule 6(1)-6(2)). Payment is made in July and January (rule 7(3)).

application_steps: Register on the MMVY portal https://www.medhavikalyan.mp.gov.in and note the user ID and password (FAQ Q22).
Submit the online application with the domicile certificate, class 10 and 12 mark sheets, entrance-exam scorecard (if applicable), income certificate, Samagra ID and item-wise fee receipt (FAQ Q23).
Submit the application print-out and documents to your institution, which verifies and recommends it.
The sanctioning authority sanctions the benefit and the disbursing authority pays the fee (SOP v1.3).
Apply again every year of the course; arrears for years not applied for are not paid (FAQ Q31-Q32).

After resolving the items above, apply through the official channel described in Automatic exclusion criteria for PMAY-G beneficiaries (Lok Sabha reply) (https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2080091).

application_steps: Get surveyed on the Awaas+ 2024 app - self-survey with Aadhaar face-authentication e-KYC in your own village, or an assisted survey by the Gram Panchayat surveyor (SOP paras 2.1-2.5).
Geo-tagged photos of the current house and proposed site are captured, then verified by the surveyor, checker / BDO and district, and the MGNREGA job card is validated (SOP paras 2.7-2.14).
The Gram Sabha verifies the list and the appellate committee reviews it (SOP para 2.15.1).
Selected households are registered on AwaasSoft with bank account, nominee and MGNREGS job card and receive a sanction order (Framework paras 4.7, 5.3).

benefit.description: Cashless and paperless hospitalisation cover of up to INR 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care at empanelled hospitals. Senior citizens aged 70+ in already covered families get an additional top-up of up to INR 5 lakh per year for themselves.

rank_reasons: Status: potentially eligible: no condition fails, some information is missing
Benefit: insurance cover (non-cash; cash benefits rank above non-cash)

next_actions.text: Add 'Household listed in SECC-2011 / NFSA ration card list' to your profile. Needed for: Household is listed in SECC-2011 or holds an MP NFSA (food security) eligibility slip. Keep your NFSA ration card / SECC listing proof ready as proof.

After resolving the items above, apply through the official channel described in Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 3915, Annexure-I (salient features of AB PM-JAY and SECC criteria) (https://sansad.in/getFile/loksabhaquestions/annex/1711/AU3915.pdf?source=pqals).

application_steps: PM-JAY is entitlement-based: eligible families can go directly to any empanelled hospital; treatment cannot be denied for lack of an Ayushman card (Lok Sabha USQ 3915 Annexure-I).
Check entitlement and create an Ayushman card on https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app; Aadhaar e-KYC is mandatory (NHA FAQ Q4, Q9).
Senior citizens aged 70+ use the same portal/app; Aadhaar is the only document needed (NHA FAQ Q5).
Helplines - 14555 (national), 18002332085 (Madhya Pradesh).
